purpose: Define rendezvous/signaling as bootstrap metadata exchange for peer discovery and WebRTC session establishment, explicitly separated from P2P application payload transport.

topics.name: Rendezvous
topics.purpose: Define rendezvous/signaling as bootstrap metadata exchange for peer discovery and WebRTC session establishment, explicitly separated from P2P application payload transport.

semantics.official_service_rule: Official rendezvous/signaling may be provided for licensed deployments; private compatible signaling is permitted.
semantics.payload_rule: Application payloads remain peer-to-peer and are not canonical rendezvous content.
semantics.metadata_rule: Rendezvous stores only metadata required for peer discovery/session bootstrap under explicit bounded retention.
semantics.cleanup_rule: Rendezvous metadata is cleaned after peer establishment/expiry according to explicit lifecycle rules.
semantics.authority_rule: Rendezvous discovery does not grant remote DWH/access rights.
semantics.identity_rule: Rendezvous records refer to explicit peer identities; endpoint/transport metadata is not the identity itself.

invariants.rule: Network identity, transport, remote authority and payload semantics remain explicit and separate.

hard_gates.condition: rendezvous becomes application payload datastore by default
endpoint address treated as peer semantic identity
bootstrap metadata retained without lifecycle bound
private compatible rendezvous prohibited as semantic requirement
peer/session metadata selected by fuzzy identity heuristic

references.purpose: Rendezvous is an explicit external boundary.

prose.summary: Define rendezvous/signaling as bootstrap metadata exchange for peer discovery and WebRTC session establishment, explicitly separated from P2P application payload transport.
notes: Unlocked until reconciled against DWH, messaging, transport and repository-wide Contract Format 1.4 validation.
